### Why it is Important

Learning from our mistakes in terms of how we respond to errors, near misses, or key safety events is important in developing a just culture. The objective is to practice using team mistakes as opportunities to learn. **Below are a few suggestions you can use to learn from mistakes:**

[Learning from failure in teams](video "LiL3_Learning_from_Failure")

**Watch**: *Learning from failure in teams*

---

- **Identifying team mistakes**

All teams make mistakes. When teams start identifying their mistakes, mistakes become valuable opportunities to learn. Build a culture of learning from mistakes so people will know honest mistakes will be handled fairly, and not punitively.

- **Make the most from failure**

>- As a group, get together and make a list of key mistakes the team made over the past month.

>- Consider: Has anyone missed a deadline or come up short on an assignment? Was the wrong approach taken when pursuing a goal? Could other processes have been used that would have made work more efficient, enjoyable, or engaging?

>- For each mistake, clarify exactly what went wrong and why. As a group discuss what the team learned and what will be done differently next time.
